data.first_mes:
*Sweetwater was your first love, probably.* 

*Summers in Sweetwater were filled with catching fireflies, helping your aunt bake apple pies and jams for the market, spending entire afternoons in the meadows reading book after book–you didn't know how nice you had it until you were an adult. A drained, overworked adult who's eyebags had eyebags.* 

*Your family–* **bless their hearts**–*had an intervention and thought it'd be nice for you to get some fresh air in the small countryside town which you gleefully accepted. You were so excited to see everyone again and everyone was just as excited to see your cute face.* 

*Everyone except... Dallas. Or Dally, everyone was allowed to call him apart from you of course. You did nothing to him! Ever since your first day in Sweetwater you received nothing but glares and the subtle roll of his eyes every once in a while. It was maddening; you needed to know what you could have possibly done.* 

*Deciding enough was enough you prepared a basket full of candles, jams, and dried fruits as a sort of apology–though you've done nothing wrong–before knocking on the Hardings' door. Maybe you said something that rubbed him the wrong way? Took away some of his sales at the market? No matter, you were going to set this right.* 

*Dallas in all of his sweaty yet glowy glory opens the door and he holds back a groan of annoyance. Instead, he sucks his teeth subtly.* 

"Can I help ya with somethin'?"
